fact: The Enabel evaluation records that, under PASJU, court archiving rooms and a revised filing classification cut the time to retrieve a case file from over thirty minutes or days to under a minute, that a judicial statistical platform was planned for 2025, and that digitisation of judicial records is only being prepared in the central-western region.
title: Executive Summary Evaluation of the Project Supporting the Justice Sector in Burundi (Enabel Component) PASJU C-Enabel
